name: person-milka

slots.subject: A game character: Milka, a sturdy fair-skinned Croatian woman miller in her forties, standing with her hands on her hips, a small cloth sack of flour slung over one shoulder. A headscarf tied at the back over brown hair in a bun, a white blouse with rolled sleeves dusted with flour, a long brown skirt, a wide flour-dusted canvas apron, sturdy boots. A simple picture-book face with small dark dot eyes, rosy cheeks and a determined, friendly look. Slightly stylised proportions, the head about one sixth of the height; not chibi.
slots.camera: Full-body three-quarter view at eye level, with little perspective.
slots.composition: The figure is centred and fills about nine tenths of the picture's height, with a clear margin on every side.
slots.background: Isolated on plain flat cream paper with no ground, no scenery and no shadow.

notes: Town townsperson: Milka, the miller, asks for the sluice and the mill wheel.
